GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 4th 3 lengths. 4th turn 3 lengths. weakened # Every Chance
Jumped Ok Settled Down well back 6 lengths. well back turn. weakened # Never Likely
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Was bumped on jumping by a runner. Raced keenly through the middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok drifted back 8l off, improved turn, Straightened Up 3-4l off, battled on well with limited room in the straight, need to see again # margin unfair
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Was held up over the concluding stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat midfield 6l off, eased 4-5 Wide turn, Straightened Up 3-4l off and worked home well without threatening # back/home ok
Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 5 lengths. got up fence turn 4 lengths. battled away # Even Effort
Slow Out 1/2 length Settled Down Mid Field 4 lengths. under pressure turn 4 lengths. battled away # Never Likely
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Approaching the 400m was taken in and had to be eased from heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped fairly. Pushed fwd & worked to race 2nd Two Wide (1L from lead) early . Stayed 2nd Two Wide midrace & pushed to quicken Five Wide (1L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Six Wide @ 300m & eased down in last 200m. # On-pace/folded.
Jumped Ok Settled Down outside leader. 2nd turn. battled on very well # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Trainer was fined the sum of $100 under AR106 for presenting the filly to race without its tongue-tie.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down outside leader. 2nd turn. weakened # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned regarding the disappointing performance of the filly, rider advised that her mount did not respond to her riding in the straight and was disappointing again following its failure at its previous start at Goulburn on 18 November 2024. A post-race veterinary examination of the filly did not reveal any abnormality.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 4th 2 lengths. hooked 3 Wide turn 2 lengths. checked 200 metres when beaten. false favourite # poor
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned regarding the disappointing performance of the filly, rider stated that when crossing from her wide draw passing the 800m her mount blundered but nevertheless travelled well in a prominent position throughout the middle stages. She added that passing the 200m her mount was taken out by rnr towards other rnr and then appeared to resent racing between runners, laid in and away from rnr and commenced to give ground. A post-race veterinary examination of the filly did not reveal any abnormality.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well showed good speed to hold box seat 1-2 Lengths off, held together turning behind leader, Straightened Up 1 Lengths off, angled for rails run 400m, hands and heel running on along fence, joined in 200m, took over 150m now under whip, drew clear and held margin on the line comfortably # had run/too good
